messages:
maria: FYI starting prep for a new APAC GPU account + VPC for the upcoming cluster bring-up. Goal: provision initial 8x A100 nodes (spot + reserved fallback), secure VPC, and hand off to SRE for validation. Need quota requests, CIDR plan, peering, and a short runbook.

ashish: 👍 which cloud/region exactly? do we have account id? also prefer keeping GPU subnet separate from infra/control plane.

maria: Region is aws ap-northeast-3 (still call it apac-n3 in docs). Account: rw-apac-prod-002 (shared with storage team but isolated OU). I'll request a service account with Org level perms for Terraform.

kai: +1 on separate subnets. I suggest three subnets: control ( /24 ), gpu-workers ( /22 ), services ( /24 ). Keep GPU workers in a single AZ initially to simplify NVLink placement.

lina: Do we want VPC peering to central logging and metrics? we need cross-account route tables and DNS resolution.

maria: yes, peer to rw-core-networking in central account. We'll need allow-listing for VPC peering and update route propagation.

ashish: I'll start the quota request for EC2 G4/G5/A100 instance types and EBS GP3 IOPS. Also request ENI and /IP addresses for scale tests. Template: "Quota request: region, instance types, target count, start date, justification" — I'll paste exact text in the SR.

cloudops: Heads-up: for reserved fallback we'll need a budget approval first. estimate: 8x A100 reserved 1yr ~ $85k/mo (ballpark). I'll create a cost estimate doc.

maria: can we consider mixed instance policy with A100 + A10G to reduce cost? but keep shape parity for perf tests.

kai: Sure, Terraform module supports instance_families var. Example snippet:

```hcl
module "gpu_cluster" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/infrastructure/modules/gpu-cluster.git"
  region = "ap-northeast-3"
  instance_families = ["p4d","g5","a10g"]
  desired_count = 8
}
```

lina: Networking notes:
- NAT gateways for control plane
- Route table entries for peering (0.0.0.0/0 via nat for control subnets)
- Security groups: allow 22/443 from corp and prometheus/metrics ports from rw-core-networking only
- DNS: enable private hosted zone association with central account

maria: validation checklist (short):
1) Terraform plan completes in staging account with same module
2) Quotas approved and limits visible
3) VPC peering established and routes propagated
4) Nodes spin up and pass GPU smoke test (run inf latency test)
5) KMS keys and IAM roles created + least-privilege for node bootstrap
6) Cost estimate and reserved purchase decision documented

ashish: I submitted quota SR# 987654321 with AWS support, included burst to 12 instances for load testing. Added justification: inference pilot + perf tests.

sre-bot: [automated] Created ticket INF-APAC-002 in `infra-oncall` and assigned to oncall for validation.

cloudops: Added preliminary cost breakdown to the ticket (storage, EBS throughput, data transfer peering). Expect ~10-15% network surcharge due to cross-account flows.

kai: small validation commands for node GPU check after spin-up:
```bash
ssh ec2-user@<node-ip> 'nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total,utilization.gpu --format=csv'
kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep gpu
```

lina: handoff notes for SRE after infra ready: include runbook with: cluster kubeconfig location, node SSH jump (bastion) instructions, monitoring dashboards, alert thresholds (GPU temp > 85C, OOM pods), and rollback steps (scale down, switch to dedicated smaller family).

maria: timeline: quota SR today, infra PR by EOD, staging apply tomorrow, production apply after successful staging smoke test (~48h). Handoff doc link will be created under confluence /infra/apac-gpu-onboard.

ashish: ping @cloudops for reserved instance approval when cost doc is ready.

cloudops: will review this afternoon. if we go mixed family we should simulate perf delta first to avoid regressions.

maria: ok i'll draft the runbook and post link here once ready. thanks all — tagging this thread for the handoff kickoff. :rocket:
